# Maple client help

A fictional client-help handoff for Rowan Alder. The app itself is not included.

- [Setup guide](docs/Guide.md)
- [Troubleshooting guide](docs/guide.md)
- [Interface colours](assets/Interface%20Colors.txt)
- [Release notes](notes/Release%3Anotes.md)
- [Keyboard shortcuts](reference/Keyboard%20shortcuts.txt)

Read both guides: setup and troubleshooting answer different questions.

# Setup guide

In the fictional Maple client, open Help from the main menu. This bundle contains documentation only. See the [interface colours](../assets/Interface%20Colors.txt).

[Back to the start](../Start%20here.md)

# Troubleshooting guide

If the help viewer is unavailable, read these UTF-8 files in a plain-text editor. Check the [release notes](../notes/Release%3Anotes.md) and [keyboard shortcuts](../reference/Keyboard%20shortcuts.txt).

[Back to the start](../Start%20here.md)

# Release notes

This fictional 2.4 help refresh uses the Help menu label consistently.

Read the [setup guide](../docs/Guide.md) before the [troubleshooting guide](../docs/guide.md).

Fictional Maple interface palette
Help link colour: #247B7B
Help panel background: #FFFFFF
Text design notes only; no rendered contrast or application test is implied.

Fictional Maple client shortcuts
F1: open Help
Ctrl+F: search within Help
Esc: close the help search
This original fictional sample may be copied and adapted for the handoff rehearsal.
